newsitem.title: UK: M&S shares extend loss amid downgrade talk.
newsitem.headline: M&S shares extend loss amid downgrade talk.

text.p: Shares in Marks & Spencer Plc extended earlier losses, trading 4-1/2 pence lower at 504-1/2 pence amid talk that a broker was planning to cut its profit forecasts.
Dealers said Natwest Markets would trim its 1997/98 pre-tax profit estimate by two to three percent on currency factors.
M&S earlier said that, based on current exchange rates, 1997/98 profits would be reduced by about 20 million stg because of the strength of the pound.
Pre-tax profit rose 10.9 percent to 1.1 billion stg in 1996/97 compared with market forecasts which had ranged between 1.1 and 1.3 billion stg.
